description: This file defines an authentication context for a React application using React Context API. It manages user authentication state, including token handling, user info, and authentication functions such as login (setAuth) and logout. It also fetches user data upon initialization if a token is found.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component that provides authentication context to child components, managing token, user info, and loading state.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook to access authentication context values.
